questions.title: Release photowright 0.21.0
questions.question: photowright is at 0.21.0 with every coverage row built, evals 15/15 and the GPU routes measured. Make the repo public and release it now?
questions.background: You chose 'public at release'. Release means: make m4bwav/photowright public, tag v0.21.0, write the wiki, install it, add it to the plugin list. Nothing goes to a package registry.
questions.why: Going public and releasing is on the list that waits for you.

options.label: Tag and install only, stay private

guess.why: The build plan is done and every check passes.
